title: The moment of imbuing
summary: How the imbued remember being woken.

claims.text: Every imbued shares the same shock of first seeing a monster for what it is, but how each one reacts in that moment, from fear and rage to something else, differs widely.
The word imbuing, passed among hunters, can feel far too tidy to those who lived through it, who recall it as a violent, sickening jolt.
